title: Island environmental history and post-switch evolutionary capacity
project_scope: post-establishment in-situ response, not an island-colonization filter
founder_policy: Identical 48-founder source state from frozen generality design; assurance alleles initially 0.5 for both modes
transfer_policy: At period 400 replace the ENTIRE visitor community history with a separately seeded near or far sequence. This is a common-community swap, not gradual island repollination; no plant migration or seed arrivals are introduced.
common_randomization: Within each setting x history x repeat x mode x pre group, run the first 400 years ONCE, then fork the exact finite plant state and RNG state into all four future scenarios. All same-post future visitor histories are paired across pre arms.
readouts: pre-switch plant occupancy and three trait means/variances
immediate post-switch per-capita viable maternal output and outcross female output
post-switch trait means/variances and 400-step realized trait response
0-vs-positive post-switch mutation interaction as realized adaptive accessibility
comparisons: far-to-near against near-to-near within matched setting/history/repeat/mode/post-mutation
near-to-far against far-to-far within matched setting/history/repeat/mode/post-mutation
post-mutation 0 against 0.01 within identical t400 state and destination
fixed versus evolving assurance interpreted as capacity-evolution intervention, not absence of selfing
inference: 4 independent visitor histories; repeats nested; pilot descriptive only; no hypothesis gate, significance or journal-route change
safeguards: never count 512 trajectories as independent histories
do not infer adaptive genetic potential from standing variance alone
no direct evolution-order intervention; this tests ecological history, not that temporal order itself caused persistence
baseline capacity 48 may yield no extinctions and would not test population rescue
isolation encoded by visitor replenishment rate, not distance in kilometres, actual species, island size, archipelago topology or field validation
do not use post-hoc pilot findings to relabel existing prospectively confirmed four-setting results
next_phase: If pilot shows identifiable contrasts, freeze independent-history confirmatory design including demographic-risk scenario and an explicit order intervention before running new histories.
